enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Move arm. Breathe audibly. Turn to left side again. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with coffee and toast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Open cupboard. Take out coffee mug. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Spread butter on toast. Eat breakfast and drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing light mobility and stretching routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Roll out yoga mat. Stand on mat. Reach arms overhead. Bend forward. Stretch back. Do lunges. Rotate torso. Do neck circles. Do ankle rotations. Roll up mat. Put mat away.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home as a physiotherapist: conducting telehealth consultations and designing exercise rehabilitation programs
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into study. Turn on computer. Adjust desk lamp. Sit on chair. Log in to computer. Open telehealth software. Put on headset. Start video call. Talk to patient. Demonstrate exercise. Take notes. End call. Type on keyboard. Review patient files. Design exercise program.
Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Prepare sandwich. Cut vegetables. Eat lunch. Drink water. Clear plate. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighbourhood for fresh air
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Walk down driveway. Turn left onto sidewalk. Walk along street. Cross road. Walk around block. Observe surroundings. Turn back. Walk back to house. Open door. Enter house. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Resuming telehealth physiotherapy sessions and writing up patient progress notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into study. Sit on chair. Turn on computer. Open telehealth software. Start video call. Talk to patient. Demonstrate exercise. Take notes. End call. Type progress notes. Save document. Open next patient file. Continue sessions. Write notes. Review notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine and doing laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Open washing machine door. Pick up laundry basket. Load clothes into machine. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Press start button.

Walk into living room. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Unwind cord. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under furniture. Turn off vacuum. Unplug. Put vacuum away.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pots and pans. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Stir. Add spices. Cook. Set table. Serve food. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.

Walk into living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Settle on program. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lean back. Put feet up. Watch more TV. Change channel. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing continuing professional development reading on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into study. Sit on chair. Turn on computer. Open web browser. Navigate to journal. Read article. Scroll down. Take notes. Highlight text. Read more. Open another tab. Search for related article. Read. Close tabs. Turn off computer. Stand up. Leave study.
Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and reading before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Move arm. Breathe audibly. Turn to left side again. Continue sleeping. Wake briefly. Turn over. Go back to sleep.
